description: This Java class, ReadableOrderProductPopulator, converts OrderProduct entities into ReadableOrderProduct data transfer objects for web display, including price calculations, product details, and images.

classes.name: ReadableOrderProductPopulator
classes.description: A class responsible for converting OrderProduct objects into ReadableOrderProduct DTOs for presentation, including product details and pricing.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts an OrderProduct entity into a ReadableOrderProduct DTO, populating fields such as price, product name, SKU, subtotal, and product image, utilizing services for product retrieval and pricing calculations.
